about: Surface minerals seen from orbit by NASA EMIT (imaging spectrometer on the ISS, 60 m pixels, +/-52 deg latitude). Per site: up to 5 clear acquisitions, the dominant 1 um (iron oxide) and 2 um (clay/carbonate/sulfate) mineral in a 300 m window, and how many acquisitions agree. Real measured data, no values invented. Sites outside EMIT coverage: dry-valleys, haughton, holuhraun, mistastin.

caveats: LP DAAC: the ten EMIT core minerals are the focus; other minerals need further validation.
Separating fine-grained goethite from hematite is an active research area.
Band depth is the strength of the best-matching absorption, not an abundance or weight percent.
No EMIT data were acquired 13 Sep 2022 - 6 Jan 2023.

rules.window: Sites: 5 x 5 cells (300 m) of the granule's own geometry lookup table (GLT, 60 m north-up WGS-84 grid; location/glt_x, glt_y + the geotransform attribute) centred on the cell holding the site point; each GLT cell points to one swath pixel (nearest neighbour), so the window is the orthorectified map view. Jordan boxes: 17 x 17 cells (~1 km) at the box centre.
rules.granules: Granules from NASA CMR whose footprint contains the point. V002 is used where an acquisition was reprocessed, otherwise V001. Sorted by the granule cloud cover in CMR, spread over seasons and dates (penalty for the same season/day); up to 5 accepted per site (max 12 tried).
rules.invalid: Left out: GLT cells without a swath pixel; pixels with fill value -9999 in mineral id or band depth (ATBD 4.2.1: -9999 = no data); pixels flagged in the matching EMIT L2A Mask granule: water flag = 1 -> water; SpecTf-Cloud flag (model probability > 0.51) or dense-cirrus flag (or spacecraft flag, where present) = 1 -> cloud. The legacy threshold Cloud/Dilated Cloud/Aggregate flags are NOT used for screening because the EMIT L2A Mask ATBD reports false positives over bright desert surfaces (they are reported as legacyCloudFlagShare); they are used only if a mask file has no SpecTf band. A granule window counts only when >= 50 % of its cells are valid.
rules.detection: Mineral id 0 = no detection (ATBD 4.2.1). Ids > 0 are Tetracorder matches that already passed the expert-system fit/depth requirements (ATBD 4.2.1); no extra fit threshold is applied because the guide/ATBD give none. Band-depth uncertainty (1 sigma, L2B MINUNCERT) is used to report "above2Sigma" = share of the dominant mineral's pixels with band depth >= 2 x uncertainty; a summary is "weak" when that share is below 0.5.
rules.mineral: Each library spectrum is named by its main EMIT-10 mineral using the EMIT grouping matrix weights (e.g. "Calcite.33+Kaol.33+Musc.33" -> Calcite, tie broken by name order); other spectra by a keyword rule or their first word. Group 1 = 1 um electronic features (iron oxides), group 2 = 2-2.5 um vibrational features (clays, carbonates, sulfates).
rules.perGranule: Dominant mineral = the most frequent mineral among valid cells with a detection, reported only if it covers >= 20 % of the valid cells (otherwise mineral = null and the scattered detections are listed under "sparse"); share = its cells / valid cells; meanBandDepth, meanBandDepthUnc and meanFit (r^2) over those cells. coreMineral = the most frequent of the ten EMIT core minerals (LP DAAC: the validated focus of the product), same 20 % rule.
rules.perSite: summary.gX.mineral = the mineral dominant in most usable granules (tie: larger summed share); agree = in how many of the usable granules it was dominant; presentIn counts granules where it is dominant or a >= 5 % secondary; core = the same vote over coreMineral (EMIT-10 only).
rules.vegetationWater: Water comes from the L2A water flag. The L2B guide has no vegetation mask; dryVegShare is the share of valid cells whose group-2 match is a dry-vegetation spectrum (grouping matrix "Vegetation" column). Green vegetation is not identified by this product.
